prompt:
Create a picture (generate an image, do not reply with text): a Fourth of July backyard question board: a wooden plank fence in the middle, a dusk sky fading from purple to orange along the top, strings of warm yellow party lights draped across the top, a small red, white and blue bunting at the top corners, and a green lawn with a glowing paper lantern along the bottom. Glossy cartoon mobile-game style matching a question board: a thick, even dark brown outline, vibrant saturated colors, smooth soft shading, clean and uncluttered. Flat straight-on front view. Canvas: a landscape 4:3 and the board fills the whole canvas edge to edge with softly rounded corners, set on a plain solid white background beyond the corners. The middle of the board (about 65% of its width and 55% of its height) must stay a calm, plain, evenly colored, low-contrast area with NO objects or detail in it, because a question will be written there; all decoration sits around the edges. No text, no numbers, no people and no buttons.
Keep the art simple and readable at small mobile-game icon sizes. Broad smooth shapes, clean even dark-brown outlines, only 2 or 3 soft shading tones per surface and one or two simple highlights. NO fine texture, intricate veins, realistic surface detail, excessive reflections or ornamental detail. A polished cute cartoon, not a highly rendered illustration. Keep the requested composition and isolated pieces.
